headline.bm: BN-PN menang PRN Melaka dan Ab Rauf dilantik semula Ketua Menteri, ketika peletakan jawatan Loke dan tahanan rumah Najib menekan kerajaan perpaduan. Iran dakwa serang pangkalan AS di Bahrain dan berkata lebih banyak kapal tangki terkena periuk api di Hormuz, Zelenskiy berkata AS cadang Donbas ditukar keahlian NATO, dan Trump, Xi serta Putin bertemu di Shenzhen pada 19 Nov. Reuters: Trump mungkin menahan serangan baharu ke atas Iran kecuali diprovokasi; PBB mahu koridor baja melalui Hormuz. Kemas kini: Loke berkata Anwar tidak perlu tunduk kepada gesaan bubar Parlimen awal.
headline.en: BN-PN wins Melaka and Ab Rauf is sworn in again as chief minister, as Loke's resignation and Najib's house arrest strain the unity government. Iran claims a drone strike on a US base in Bahrain and says more tankers hit mines in Hormuz, Zelenskiy says the US floated Donbas-for-NATO, and Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen on 19 Nov. Reuters: Trump may hold off new Iran strikes unless provoked; the UN wants a fertiliser corridor through Hormuz. Update: Loke says Anwar need not bow to calls for early dissolution of Parliament.

summary.bm: Marcos merasmikan sidang tiga hari itu pada 15 Nov dan berkata masalah serantau bergerak lebih pantas daripada kemampuan satu negara. Li Qiang bertemu pemimpin ASEAN 16 Nov; Trump tiba 17 Nov untuk mesyuarat Quad dan ASEAN-AS sebelum APEC di Shenzhen.
summary.en: Marcos opened the three-day summit on 15 Nov, saying regional problems are moving faster than any one country can handle. Li Qiang meets ASEAN leaders on 16 Nov; Trump lands on 17 Nov for the Quad and ASEAN-US meetings before APEC in Shenzhen.

title.bm: Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-49 dibuka di Manila dengan perang dan Laut China Selatan dalam agenda
title.en: 49th ASEAN Summit opens in Manila with wars and the South China Sea on the agenda

why.bm: Pembabitan diplomatik utama Malaysia minggu ini; nada perdagangan dan keselamatan terhadap AS dan China penting untuk eksport.
why.en: Malaysia's main diplomatic engagement this week; trade and security tone toward US and China matters for exports.

summary.bm: Ab Rauf Yusoh mengangkat sumpah jam 12.10 tengah hari pada 15 Nov sebagai Ketua Menteri Melaka ke-13. BN menang 21 dan PN 3 daripada 28 kerusi (dua pertiga), PH 4; beliau mengekalkan Tanjung Bidara dengan majoriti 8,615 undi.
summary.en: Ab Rauf Yusoh took the oath at 12.10pm on 15 Nov as the 13th Melaka chief minister. BN won 21 and PN 3 of 28 seats (two-thirds), PH 4; he held Tanjung Bidara by 8,615 votes.

title.bm: Ab Rauf mengangkat sumpah penggal kedua Ketua Menteri Melaka selepas kemenangan besar BN-PN
title.en: Ab Rauf sworn in for a second term as Melaka chief minister after BN-PN landslide

why.bm: Ujian negeri pertama bagi landskap PRU16 dan kemunduran buat PH, sebahagiannya berkaitan isu Najib.
why.en: First state test of GE16 battle lines and a setback for PH, partly over the Najib issue.

summary.bm: Loke meletak jawatan menteri pengangkutan Selasa lalu selepas keputusan tahanan rumah Najib; Anwar telah menerima surat itu tetapi belum membuat keputusan dan sedang berunding. Naib Pengerusi DAP Teo Nie Ching berkata pada 15 Nov langkah itu bukan tergesa-gesa, dan Loke menegaskan MP DAP masih menyokong Anwar. Pada konvensyen DAP Johor 15 Nov, Loke turut berkata Anwar tidak perlu akur kepada desakan pembubaran awal Parlimen selagi mempunyai majoriti, dengan baki penggal kira-kira setahun.
summary.en: Loke resigned as transport minister on Tuesday after the Najib house-arrest ruling; Anwar has the letter but says he has not decided and is consulting. DAP vice-chairman Teo Nie Ching said on 15 Nov the move was not hasty, and Loke says DAP MPs still back Anwar. At a Johor DAP convention on 15 Nov, Loke also said Anwar need not bow to calls for early dissolution while he holds a majority, with about a year left in the term.

title.bm: Peletakan jawatan Loke sebagai Menteri Pengangkutan masih belum selesai, Anwar mahu rundingan lanjut
title.en: Loke's resignation as transport minister still pending as Anwar seeks more talks

why.bm: Ia menunjukkan ketegangan antara Umno dan DAP dalam kerajaan perpaduan.
why.en: It shows strain between Umno and DAP inside the unity government.

summary.bm: Setiausaha Agung DAP Anthony Loke berkata selagi Perdana Menteri mendapat sokongan majoriti Dewan Rakyat, tiada sebab untuk beliau tunduk kepada tekanan, dan kerajaan masih ada kira-kira setahun untuk agenda reformasi. Beliau menambah pembubaran Parlimen adalah kuasa Yang di-Pertuan Agong atas nasihat PM, dan pemimpin PH kekal bersatu di belakang Anwar.
summary.en: DAP's Anthony Loke said that as long as the PM commands a Dewan Rakyat majority there is no reason to yield, and that the government has about a year left for reforms. He added that dissolution is the Agong's power on the PM's advice and PH leaders remain united behind Anwar.

title.bm: Loke: Anwar tidak perlu tunduk kepada gesaan bubar Parlimen awal
title.en: Loke: Anwar need not bow to calls for early dissolution of Parliament

why.bm: Petanda kerajaan perpaduan mahu menamatkan penggal walaupun kalah di Melaka dan ada ketegangan dalam Kabinet.
why.en: Signals the unity government intends to run its term despite the Melaka loss and cabinet strain.

summary.bm: Anwar berkata Malaysia berdepan ribuan cubaan serangan sebulan dan beliau bertemu pimpinan tentera mengenai pengukuhan unit siber ATM. Beliau berkata peruntukan pertahanan adalah tertinggi dalam sejarah untuk menggantikan kapal, pesawat dan kenderaan perisai usang.
summary.en: Anwar said Malaysia faces thousands of attack attempts a month and that he met armed forces leaders about strengthening the military cyber unit. He said defence allocation is the highest in history, to replace obsolete ships, aircraft and armoured vehicles.

title.bm: PM: ancaman siber, pencerobohan dan keganasan teratas agenda keselamatan negara
title.en: PM: cyber, intrusion and terror threats top Malaysia's security agenda

why.bm: Menandakan perbelanjaan lebih tinggi untuk pertahanan siber dan angkatan tentera.
why.en: Signals higher spending on cyber defence and the armed forces.

summary.bm: Anwar menegur agensi kerana Selangor dilanda banjir empat hingga lima kali setahun, merujuk peruntukan banjir RM2.2 bilion. Bantuan persekutuan dinaikkan daripada RM1,000 kepada RM2,500; pada 4 petang 14 Nov Kuala Selangor mempunyai 1,511 mangsa dan Hilir Perak 227.
summary.en: Anwar criticised agencies over Selangor flooding four to five times a year, citing the RM2.2b flood allocation. Federal aid was raised from RM1,000 to RM2,500; at 4pm on 14 Nov Kuala Selangor had 1,511 evacuees and Hilir Perak 227.

title.bm: Anwar arah tindakan segera atasi banjir ketika mangsa Selangor capai 1,511
title.en: Anwar orders immediate flood mitigation as Selangor evacuees reach 1,511

why.bm: Banjir berulang menguji keberkesanan kerajaan persekutuan dan negeri.
why.en: Repeat floods test federal and state delivery.

summary.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin memaklumkan Dewan bahawa Najib hanya boleh tinggal bersama keluarga terdekat dan perlu kelulusan bertulis untuk tetamu. Perintah itu berkuat kuasa hingga 23 Ogos 2028; Anwar menafikan mengingkari Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
summary.en: Home Minister Saifuddin told Parliament Najib may live only with immediate family and needs written approval for guests. The order runs to 23 Aug 2028; Anwar denies defying the King.

title.bm: Tahanan rumah Najib: keluarga terdekat sahaja, tiada telefon, tidak boleh keluar walaupun untuk solat Jumaat
title.en: Najib's house arrest: immediate family only, no phones, no leaving even for Friday prayers

why.bm: Isu ini mencorak undi Melaka dan perpecahan Umno–DAP.
why.en: It is the issue driving the Melaka vote and the Umno–DAP rift.

summary.bm: Defisit susut daripada 6.4% (2021) kepada 3.7% (2025) dan diunjur 3.3% pada 2027. Hutang persekutuan 65.2% daripada KDNK, menurun kepada 63% pada 2027; GST hanya boleh dipertimbang jika pendapatan minimum mencapai RM4,000.
summary.en: The deficit fell from 6.4% (2021) to 3.7% (2025) and is projected at 3.3% in 2027. Federal debt is 65.2% of GDP, easing to 63% in 2027; GST could be considered only if minimum incomes reach RM4,000.

title.bm: Anwar: tiada rancangan laksana semula GST; defisit fiskal turun kepada 3.7% pada 2025
title.en: Anwar: no plan to bring back GST; fiscal deficit down to 3.7% in 2025

why.bm: Menetapkan hala tuju fiskal semasa perbahasan Belanjawan 2027.
why.en: Sets the fiscal direction during the Budget 2027 debate.

summary.bm: Di bawah Belanjawan 2027 gaji minimum naik daripada RM1,700 kepada RM2,000; firma dengan jualan di bawah RM50 juta dikecualikan. Gaji sara hidup GLC naik daripada RM3,100 kepada RM3,400 (kira-kira 230,000 pekerja).
summary.en: Under Budget 2027 the minimum wage goes from RM1,700 to RM2,000; firms with sales under RM50m are exempt. The GLC living wage rises from RM3,100 to RM3,400 (about 230,000 workers).

title.bm: Gaji minimum naik kepada RM2,000 mulai Jun 2027
title.en: Minimum wage to rise to RM2,000 from June 2027

why.bm: Menjejaskan kos upah dan kos sara hidup.
why.en: Affects wage costs and the cost of living.

summary.bm: Pada 4 petang, 1,738 mangsa berada di 8 PPS: 1,511 daripada 405 keluarga di Kuala Selangor dan 227 di Hilir Perak. SK Parit Mahang pusat terbesar dengan 433 orang.
summary.en: At 4pm, 1,738 people were in 8 relief centres: 1,511 from 405 families in Kuala Selangor and 227 in Hilir Perak. SK Parit Mahang is the largest centre with 433.

title.bm: Mangsa banjir Selangor meningkat kepada 1,511, Perak berkurang kepada 227
title.en: Selangor flood evacuees rise to 1,511 while Perak eases to 227

why.bm: Selangor masih meningkat manakala Perak reda.
why.en: Selangor is still rising while Perak eases.

summary.bm: Pada sambutan di Brickfields, Anwar berkata kerajaan komited menangani isu komuniti India termasuk kuil, peniaga dan keluarga miskin. Beliau menyebut Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah, Sumbangan Asas Rahmah dan RM200 bagi setiap murid sekolah pada Januari.
summary.en: At the Brickfields celebration, Anwar said the government is committed to Indian community issues including temples, traders and poor families. He cited Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah, Sumbangan Asas Rahmah and RM200 for every schoolchild in January.

title.bm: Anwar di sambutan Deepavali peringkat kebangsaan: RM200 untuk setiap murid sekolah pada Januari
title.en: Anwar at national Deepavali event: RM200 for every schoolchild in January

why.bm: Bantuan tunai terus untuk keluarga dan murid sekolah.
why.en: Direct cash aid for families and schoolchildren.

summary.bm: Wang Yudong dan Zhang Yuning menjaringkan gol; gol minit ke-77 Fergus Tierney dibatalkan VAR kerana offside. Malaysia belum menewaskan China sejak 1980.
summary.en: Wang Yudong and Zhang Yuning scored; Fergus Tierney's 77th-minute goal was ruled out by VAR for offside. Malaysia has not beaten China since 1980.

title.bm: China tewaskan Harimau Malaya 2-0 dalam perlawanan persahabatan di Zhaoqing
title.en: China beat Harimau Malaya 2-0 in Zhaoqing friendly

why.bm: Rekod tanpa kemenangan menentang China berlanjutan 46 tahun.
why.en: Winless run against China extends to 46 years.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi berkata Perdana Menteri bimbang tentang protokol keselamatan anggota polis susulan serangan di Kepong. Butiran lanjut terdapat dalam laporan Malay Mail.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi says the Prime Minister is concerned about safety protocols for police officers following the Kepong attack. Further details were in the Malay Mail report.

title.bm: Anwar bimbang protokol keselamatan polis selepas serangan di Kepong
title.en: Anwar concerned over police safety protocols after Kepong attack

why.bm: Berkait keselamatan anggota barisan hadapan dan ketenteraman awam.
why.en: Touches on frontline police safety and public order.

summary.bm: 32 kertas siasatan itu daripada 42 laporan sepanjang 14 hari kempen, merangkumi merobek bendera dan ucapan didakwa menghasut. Kira-kira 3,300 anggota ditugaskan pada hari mengundi.
summary.en: The 32 papers came from 42 reports during the 14-day campaign, covering flag tearing and allegedly seditious speeches. About 3,300 personnel were deployed on polling day.

title.bm: Polis rujuk 32 kertas siasatan PRN Melaka kepada AGC
title.en: Police refer 32 Melaka election investigation papers to AGC

why.bm: Menunjukkan penguatkuasaan ketat terhadap tingkah laku kempen.
why.en: Shows how strictly campaign conduct is policed.

summary.bm: Dua belas daripada 14 yang ditahan warga Taiwan; polis merampas 170 barang termasuk 69 telefon dan 70 kad SIM. Suspek didakwa menyamar sebagai polis Taiwan.
summary.en: Twelve of the 14 arrested are Taiwanese; police seized 170 items including 69 phones and 70 SIM cards. The suspects allegedly posed as Taiwanese police.

title.bm: Polis serbu 18 chalet di Bentong dijadikan pusat panggilan penipuan; 14 ditahan
title.en: Police raid 18 Bentong chalets used as scam call centres; 14 arrested

why.bm: Sindiket asing beroperasi dari unit penginapan percutian yang disewa.
why.en: Foreign syndicates are operating from rented holiday units.

summary.bm: Suspek didakwa menjerut ibunya yang berusia 50-an; kes disiasat mengikut Seksyen 302.
summary.en: The suspect allegedly strangled his mother, in her 50s; the case is probed under Section 302.

title.bm: Banting: lelaki berusia 20-an direman tujuh hari atas kematian ibu, positif metamfetamina
title.en: Banting: man in his 20s remanded seven days over mother's death, tests positive for meth

why.bm: Satu lagi kes disyaki keganasan keluarga berkaitan dadah.
why.en: Another case of suspected drug-linked family violence.

summary.bm: Amaran sehingga 6 petang meliputi Pulau Pinang, Kedah, Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah dan Sarawak.
summary.en: The warning until 6pm covers Penang, Kedah, Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah and Sarawak.

title.bm: MetMalaysia beri amaran ribut petir dan angin kencang di tujuh negeri serta KL dan Putrajaya
title.en: MetMalaysia warns of thunderstorms and strong winds in seven states plus KL and Putrajaya

why.bm: Menambah risiko banjir yang sedang berlaku di Selangor dan Perak.
why.en: Adds to ongoing floods in Selangor and Perak.

summary.bm: Laluan Rel Pantai Timur memulakan percubaan akhir menjelang pelancaran perkhidmatan penumpang 12 Dis.
summary.en: The East Coast Rail Link begins its final trial run ahead of the Dec 12 passenger service launch.

title.bm: ECRL masuk percubaan akhir sebelum perkhidmatan penumpang 12 Dis
title.en: ECRL enters final trial run before Dec 12 passenger launch

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan Pantai Timur untuk Disember.
why.en: Plan East Coast travel for December.

summary.bm: Pergaduhan 7 Nov mengakibatkan seorang lelaki maut akibat tikaman; polis menahan seramai 23 orang.
summary.en: A 7 Nov fight left one man dead from a stab wound; police have detained 23 people in total.

title.bm: Kes pergaduhan maut Sibu: 14 lagi direman sehingga 18 Nov
title.en: Sibu fight death: 14 more remanded until 18 Nov

why.bm: Polis menggesa orang ramai tidak membuat spekulasi.
why.en: Police urge the public not to speculate.

summary.bm: Lelaki berusia 30 tahun mengaku bersalah pada 11 Nov atas serangan pisau 4 Nov di luar sekolah dan dipenjara mengikut Seksyen 324.
summary.en: A 30-year-old pleaded guilty on 11 Nov to a 4 Nov knife attack outside a school and was jailed under Section 324.

title.bm: Video tetak di George Town tular sudah seminggu; lelaki dipenjara lapan bulan
title.en: Viral George Town slashing video is a week old; man already jailed eight months

why.bm: Polis berkata kes telah selesai; elakkan berkongsi video lama sebagai baharu.
why.en: Police say the case is closed; avoid sharing old videos as new.

summary.bm: Kes jenayah komputer Jan-Okt meningkat kepada 1,297 daripada 1,174, manakala kerugian turun kepada RM125.62 juta daripada RM239.2 juta.
summary.en: Jan-Oct computer crime cases rose to 1,297 from 1,174, while losses fell to RM125.62m from RM239.2m.

title.bm: JSJK: 16 laporan ancaman siber Oktober dengan kerugian RM79.16 juta
title.en: CCID: 16 cyber threat reports in October with RM79.16m in losses

why.bm: Kes meningkat tetapi jumlah kerugian menurun.
why.en: Cases are up but total losses are down.

summary.bm: Pemegang UEC dengan B4 dalam lima subjek ditetapkan kekal layak; UEC sahaja tidak diterima universiti awam yang menggunakan SPM.
summary.en: UEC holders with B4 in five prescribed subjects remain eligible; UEC alone is not accepted for public universities, which use SPM.

title.bm: Kabinet kekalkan syarat kemasukan UEC untuk ijazah perubatan swasta
title.en: Cabinet keeps UEC entry rules for private medical degrees

why.bm: Menyelesaikan laluan kemasukan yang dipertikai untuk pelajar perubatan.
why.en: Settles a disputed entry route for medical students.

summary.bm: Mayat seorang warga India ditemui pada 3.40 petang 13 Nov, mangsa ketujuh limpahan air di Hulu Selangor. Seorang daripada lapan yang dilaporkan hilang masih belum ditemui.
summary.en: The body of an Indian national was found at 3.40pm on 13 Nov, the seventh victim of the water surge in Hulu Selangor. One of the eight reported missing is still unaccounted for.

title.bm: Limpahan Sungai Pertak: mangsa ketujuh ditemui, seorang masih hilang
title.en: Sungai Pertak surge: seventh victim found, one still missing

why.bm: Jauhi sungai dan kawasan rekreasi ketika hujan lebat.
why.en: Stay away from rivers and recreation areas during heavy rain.

summary.bm: Pakar bedah menyambung semula tangan seorang anggota polis yang cedera dalam serangan di Kepong. Dalam kes berasingan, empat warga asing direman sehingga 17 Nov atas rompakan dan serangan terhadap anggota polis di Pulau Pinang.
summary.en: Surgeons reattached the hand of a policeman injured in an attack in Kepong. Separately, four foreigners were remanded until Nov 17 over the robbery and assault of a police officer in Penang.

title.bm: Doktor sambung semula tangan polis yang dikapak dalam serangan di Kepong
title.en: Doctors reattach policeman's hand chopped off in Kepong attack

why.bm: Menunjukkan risiko yang dihadapi anggota barisan hadapan.
why.en: Shows the risks frontline officers face.

summary.bm: Jumlah bekerja 16.82 juta; Putrajaya terendah 1.3% manakala Melaka dan Selangor 2.0%.
summary.en: The employed total is 16.82m; Putrajaya is lowest at 1.3% while Melaka and Selangor are at 2.0%.

title.bm: Pengangguran suku ketiga kekal 3.0%, 513,700 penganggur
title.en: Q3 unemployment steady at 3.0%, 513,700 jobless

why.bm: Pasaran buruh stabil menjelang kenaikan gaji minimum.
why.en: The labour market is stable ahead of the minimum wage rise.

summary.bm: Kerajaan akan memberi subsidi RM15 juta sebulan apabila kos minyak sawit meningkat, menurut Malay Mail.
summary.en: The government will provide a RM15 million monthly subsidy as palm oil costs rise, per Malay Mail.

title.bm: Kerajaan beri subsidi RM15 juta sebulan apabila kos minyak sawit meningkat
title.en: Govt steps in with RM15m monthly subsidy as palm oil costs rise

why.bm: Bertujuan meredakan harga minyak masak bagi pengguna.
why.en: Aims to cushion cooking-oil prices for consumers.

summary.bm: Agensi Pengurusan Bencana Negara berkata 102,000 anggota dikerahkan bagi musim monsun.
summary.en: The National Disaster Management Agency says 102,000 personnel are being deployed for the monsoon season.

title.bm: Nadma kerah 102,000 anggota menjelang Monsun Timur Laut 2026/2027
title.en: Nadma deploys 102,000 personnel ahead of the 2026/2027 northeast monsoon

why.bm: Sediakan kit kecemasan dan ikuti amaran banjir rasmi.
why.en: Prepare an emergency kit and follow official flood warnings.

summary.bm: Bantuan tunai RM2,500 diberikan kepada mangsa banjir Selangor yang layak; Kosmo menyatakan bayaran bermula 10 Nov.
summary.en: Cash aid of RM2,500 goes to eligible Selangor flood victims, with Kosmo saying payments start Nov 10.

title.bm: Anwar umum bantuan banjir RM2,500 setiap isi rumah layak di Selangor
title.en: Anwar announces RM2,500 flood aid per eligible Selangor household

why.bm: Isi rumah terjejas patut semak kelayakan dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan.
why.en: Affected households should check eligibility with local authorities.

summary.bm: Ketua Pengarah Pendidikan Tinggi berkata saringan pelajar asing akan diperketat. Langkah ini bertujuan melindungi kualiti dan integriti institusi tempatan.
summary.en: The Higher Education director-general says screening of foreign students will be tightened. The move is aimed at safeguarding the quality and integrity of local institutions.

title.bm: Malaysia ketatkan saringan pelajar antarabangsa untuk lindungi mutu pendidikan tinggi
title.en: Malaysia tightens screening of international students to protect higher-education standards

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada universiti dan bakal pelajar antarabangsa.
why.en: Affects universities and prospective international students.

summary.bm: Dalam satu daripada tiga pertikaian, tribunal mengawardkan RM2,000 dengan faedah 8% dan mendapati Auto Accept serta Fast Cancel melanggar Akta Pekerja Gig 2025. Dalam kes lain, penyahaktifan seorang pemandu atas salah laku disahkan.
summary.en: In one of three disputes the tribunal awarded RM2,000 with 8% interest and found Auto Accept and Fast Cancel breached the Gig Workers Act 2025. In another it upheld a driver's deactivation over misconduct.

title.bm: Tribunal Pekerja Gig putuskan auto-accept GrabCar langgar hak pemandu
title.en: Gig Workers Tribunal rules GrabCar's auto-accept breaches drivers' rights

why.bm: Ujian awal undang-undang pekerja gig baharu bagi pemandu e-hailing.
why.en: An early test of the new gig-worker law for e-hailing drivers.

summary.bm: Emas spot sekitar $3,888 pada Jumaat selepas menyentuh $3,852 pada Khamis, terendah sejak Okt 2025, turun lebih 4% seminggu. Indeks dolar hampir 103.18.
summary.en: Spot gold was about $3,888 on Friday after touching $3,852 on Thursday, the lowest since Oct 2025, down more than 4% on the week. The dollar index was near 103.18.

title.bm: Emas catat minggu terburuk dalam empat bulan ketika jangkaan kenaikan Fed dan dolar menekan
title.en: Gold has its worst week in four months as Fed-hike bets and dollar weigh

why.bm: Jangkaan Fed lebih tegas menekan emas dan ringgit.
why.en: Hawkish Fed expectations weigh on gold and the ringgit.

summary.bm: Seorang pegawai PBB di COP31 Antalya meminta Iran dan AS membenarkan lima kapal baja sehari melalui selat itu. Satu pertiga baja dunia melaluinya sebelum konflik, dan 45 juta orang boleh berdepan kekurangan makanan teruk jika musim tanaman terlepas.
summary.en: A UN official at COP31 in Antalya asked Iran and the US to allow five fertiliser vessels a day through the strait. A third of the world's fertiliser passed through it before the conflict, and 45 million people could face acute food insecurity if planting seasons are missed.

title.bm: PBB gesa koridor Hormuz terhad masa untuk kapal baja apabila harga naik 30%
title.en: UN urges time-bound Hormuz corridor for fertiliser ships as prices rise 30%

why.bm: Baja lebih mahal boleh menaikkan kos makanan dan input kelapa sawit di Asia, termasuk Malaysia.
why.en: Costlier fertiliser can push up food and palm oil input costs across Asia, including Malaysia.

summary.bm: Brent berada pada $95.41 dan WTI $88.52 awal pagi Jumaat, turun sekitar 2.4% dan 2.5% minggu ini selepas susut 16% dan 13% minggu lalu. Stok minyak mentah AS naik 4.7 juta tong kepada 414.4 juta, manakala serangan Houthi ke atas infrastruktur Saudi dan serangan kapal tangki di Hormuz mengekalkan risiko bekalan.
summary.en: Brent was at $95.41 and WTI $88.52 early Friday, down about 2.4% and 2.5% on the week after drops of 16% and 13% the week before. US crude stocks rose 4.7 million barrels to 414.4 million, while Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and Hormuz tanker hits kept supply risk high.

title.bm: Minyak menuju penurunan mingguan kedua dekat $95 apabila Trump kekalkan sekatan Iran
title.en: Oil heads for a second weekly fall near $95 as Trump keeps the Iran blockade

why.bm: Minyak hampir $95 masih menekan harga bahan api, subsidi dan inflasi di Malaysia.
why.en: Oil near $95 still feeds fuel, subsidy and inflation pressure in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Indeks dolar sekitar 103.17 dan menuju kenaikan mingguan terbesar dalam lebih sebulan, manakala yen sempat mencecah 160 sedolar. CME FedWatch menunjukkan peluang 14.5% kenaikan 50 mata asas pada Disember, berbanding sifar seminggu lalu; hasil 10 tahun mencecah 5.1433%.
summary.en: The dollar index is about 103.17, set for its biggest weekly gain in over a month, and the yen briefly touched 160 per dollar. CME FedWatch shows a 14.5% chance of a 50bp December hike, from zero a week ago; the 10-year yield hit a three-week high of 5.1433%.

title.bm: Dolar hampir paras tertinggi 19 bulan apabila pedagang meramal kenaikan kadar Fed; hasil 10 tahun 5.14%
title.en: Dollar near 19-month high as traders price possible Fed hike; 10-year yield at 5.14%

why.bm: Dolar lebih kukuh dan hasil lebih tinggi menekan ringgit dan Bursa serta menaikkan kos import.
why.en: A stronger dollar and higher yields weigh on the ringgit and Bursa and raise import costs.

summary.bm: Trump mengugut pada 12 Nov untuk menggandakan tarif AS ke atas barangan termasuk keluli, aluminium dan kenderaan melainkan karavan kira-kira 1,000-1,500 pendatang dihalang. Sheinbaum berkata tiada karavan sampai ke sempadan utara sejak Januari 2025.
summary.en: Trump threatened on 12 Nov to double US tariffs on goods including steel, aluminium and vehicles unless a caravan of about 1,000-1,500 migrants is stopped. Sheinbaum says no caravan has reached the northern border since January 2025.

title.bm: Trump ugut gandakan tarif ke atas Mexico kerana karavan pendatang
title.en: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico over migrant caravan

why.bm: Peningkatan tarif menjejaskan rantaian bekalan yang dibekalkan pengeksport Malaysia.
why.en: Tariff escalation hits supply chains that Malaysian exporters feed into.

summary.bm: Pertumbuhan tahunan 1.9%. Timbalan Gabenor BoE Lombardelli berkata kejutan tenaga lebih lama daripada dijangka, menguatkan hujah kenaikan kadar lagi; sidang kemuncak UK-EU dijadual 20 Nov.
summary.en: Annual growth was 1.9%. BoE Deputy Governor Lombardelli said the energy shock has lasted longer than expected, strengthening the case for more hikes; a UK-EU summit is set for 20 Nov.

title.bm: KDNK UK suku ketiga naik 0.7%, terkukuh dalam lebih dua tahun, BoE beri amaran kejutan tenaga berpanjangan
title.en: UK Q3 GDP grows 0.7%, strongest in over two years, as BoE warns energy shock lasts longer

why.bm: Kadar tinggi lebih lama di ekonomi utama mengekalkan pembiayaan global ketat.
why.en: Higher-for-longer rates in major economies keep global financing tight.

summary.bm: Beijing mengecam penggunaan dakwaan "pengintipan" Nvidia oleh AS untuk mempertahankan sekatan teknologi, merumitkan pertemuan Xi-Trump minggu depan. Gencatan setahun itu tamat pada Januari. Senator Demokrat meminta rekod eksport Nvidia dipelihara.
summary.en: Beijing denounced US use of Nvidia "spying" claims to defend tech curbs, complicating next week's Xi-Trump meeting. The year-long truce expires in January. Democratic senators asked the administration to preserve Nvidia export records.

title.bm: Pertikaian Nvidia menguji gencatan dagang AS-China menjelang kunjungan Trump ke Xi minggu depan
title.en: Nvidia row tests US-China trade truce as Xi set to welcome Trump next week

why.bm: Kegagalan rundingan boleh menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia yang bergantung pada eksport.
why.en: A breakdown would hit chip supply chains and Malaysia's export-driven semiconductor sector.

summary.bm: Sebuah bangunan pangsapuri di Brooklyn runtuh ke tapak pembinaan bersebelahan pada Rabu, membunuh lapan orang menurut Datuk Bandar New York, Zohran Mamdani.
summary.en: An apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed into an adjacent construction site on Wednesday, killing eight people, according to NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

title.bm: Lapan maut apabila bangunan pangsapuri Brooklyn runtuh ke tapak pembinaan bersebelahan
title.en: Eight killed as Brooklyn apartment building collapses into neighbouring construction site

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan pembinaan dan pengawasan berhampiran bangunan berpenghuni.
why.en: Raises questions on construction safety and oversight near occupied buildings.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan lebihan dagangan China melonjak melepasi AS$1 trilion, didorong eksport berkaitan AI.
summary.en: FMT reports China's trade surplus surged past US$1tn, powered by AI-related exports.

title.bm: Lebihan dagangan China melepasi AS$1 trilion apabila ledakan AI menaikkan eksport
title.en: China's trade surplus passes US$1 trillion as AI boom lifts exports

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko ketegangan dagangan menjelang sidang APEC dan memberi kesan kepada eksport elektronik Malaysia.
why.en: Raises trade-tension risk ahead of the APEC summit and affects Malaysia's electronics exports.

summary.bm: Setakat 12 Nov terdapat 43 wabak baharu dan 591 dimasukkan hospital; 96% pesakit tidak divaksin atau status tidak diketahui. CDC menyenaraikan 6 kematian, walaupun sesetengah laporan menyebut angka lebih tinggi.
summary.en: As of 12 Nov there were 43 new outbreaks and 591 hospitalisations; 96% of patients were unvaccinated or of unknown status. CDC lists 6 deaths, though some reports cite higher figures.

title.bm: Campak AS: CDC rekod 5,412 kes disahkan, naik 230 dalam seminggu
title.en: US measles: CDC counts 5,412 confirmed cases, up 230 in a week

why.bm: Pastikan vaksin MMR anak dikemas kini sebelum bepergian.
why.en: Check that your children's MMR is up to date before travel.

summary.bm: Setakat 10 Nov, ECDC merekodkan 11,114 kes disahkan dan 5,433 kematian di lapan wilayah, Ituri 7,728 kes. Kenya melaporkan 9 kes (tiada sejak 20 Okt); tiada vaksin atau rawatan diluluskan dan ujian klinikal sedang berjalan di Bunia.
summary.en: As of 10 Nov, ECDC counts 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths across eight provinces, with Ituri at 7,728 cases. Kenya reported 9 cases (none since 20 Oct); no approved vaccine or treatment exists and a trial is under way in Bunia.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC lebih 11,100 kes disahkan dan 5,400 kematian, kata ECDC
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC passes 11,100 confirmed cases and 5,400 deaths, ECDC says

why.bm: WHO tidak menggalakkan larangan perjalanan; elakkan bersentuhan dengan pesakit dan dapatkan rawatan jika demam selepas pulang dari kawasan terjejas.
why.en: WHO advises against travel bans; avoid contact with the sick and seek care for fever after travel to affected areas.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: ChAdOx1 Oxford/Serum Institute dan mRNA-1469 Moderna akan menyertai ujian Tumaini yang bermula 23 Okt di Bunia dengan vaksinasi cincin. WHO merekodkan lebih 10,500 kes dan 5,126 kematian setakat 1 Nov.
summary.en: Oxford/Serum Institute ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469 will join the Tumaini trial, which began Oct 23 in Bunia with ring vaccination. WHO counted over 10,500 cases and 5,126 deaths as of Nov 1.

title.bm: WHO tambah dua calon vaksin khusus Bundibugyo ke ujian Ebola DRC
title.en: WHO adds two Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidates to DRC Ebola trial

why.bm: Pelancong ke kawasan terjejas patut mengikut nasihat KKM dan WHO.
why.en: Travellers to affected areas should follow KKM and WHO advisories.

summary.bm: IRGC berkata enam dron mengenai radar pertahanan udara di pangkalan Riffa pada hari Ahad; CENTCOM sebelum ini berkata dua dron dipintas tanpa kerosakan dan belum mengesahkan dakwaan baharu. Pertahanan udara Saudi turut memintas dua peluru berpandu balistik Houthi ke arah Riyadh; tiada korban dilaporkan.
summary.en: The IRGC says six drones hit an air-defence radar at Riffa air base on Sunday; US Central Command earlier said it intercepted two drones with no damage and has not confirmed the new claim. Saudi air defences also intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh; no casualties reported.

title.bm: Pengawal Revolusi Iran dakwa serang pangkalan AS di Bahrain; Bahrain keluarkan amaran seluruh negara
title.en: Iran's Guards claim drone strike on US base in Bahrain; Bahrain issues nationwide alert

why.bm: Serangan yang meluas di Teluk mengekalkan risiko minyak, tambang kargo dan kos bahan api Malaysia; semua dakwaan serangan belum disahkan.
why.en: Widening Gulf attacks keep oil, freight and Malaysian fuel-cost risks high; all attack claims are unverified.

summary.bm: Reuters, memetik tiga sumber, melaporkan Trump memberitahu penasihat bahawa beliau mungkin tidak melancarkan serangan baharu kecuali Tehran atau Houthi mencetuskan tindakan baharu, tanpa keputusan muktamad. Kapal induk AS ketiga sedang menuju ke rantau itu manakala Arab Saudi dan Turkiye menggesa menahan diri dan pegawai Israel mendesak tindakan semula.
summary.en: Reuters, citing three sources, reports Trump told advisers he may refrain from new strikes unless Tehran or the Houthis provoke fresh action, with no final decision yet. A third US carrier is heading to the region while Saudi Arabia and Turkey urge restraint and Israeli officials press for renewed action.

title.bm: Trump menimbang untuk tidak melancarkan serangan lanjut ke atas Iran kecuali diprovokasi, kata sumber Reuters
title.en: Trump weighs holding off further Iran strikes unless provoked, Reuters sources say

why.bm: Jeda boleh meredakan risiko Hormuz dan minyak ke atas kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia, tetapi isyarat ini belum disahkan dan boleh berubah.
why.en: A pause would ease Hormuz and oil risk for Malaysia's fuel and freight costs, but the signal is unconfirmed and reversible.

summary.bm: Tentera laut Iran berkata lebih banyak kapal tangki terkena periuk api laut dan terbakar di timur selat, tujuh insiden dalam 24 jam; Iran mengaitkan pembukaan semula selat dengan penamatan sekatan AS. Dakwaan belum disahkan, tiada nama kapal atau korban dilaporkan; harga baja naik 30%.
summary.en: Iran's navy says more tankers hit naval mines and caught fire in the eastern strait, seven incidents in 24 hours; Iran ties reopening to an end to the US blockade. Claims are unverified, no vessel names or casualties reported; fertiliser prices are up 30%.

title.bm: Iran berkata tiga kapal tangki minyak terkena periuk api laut di Selat Hormuz, satu terbakar
title.en: Iran says three oil tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz, one on fire

why.bm: Serangan berulang terhadap perkapalan mengekalkan risiko harga minyak serta kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia; dakwaan ini daripada sumber negara Iran.
why.en: Repeated hits on shipping keep oil prices and Malaysian fuel and freight costs exposed; claims come from Iranian state sources.

summary.bm: Rumah Putih berkata ketiga-tiga pemimpin akan bertemu di sebalik APEC di Shenzhen pada 19 Nov (Kremlin), pertemuan tiga hala pertama mereka, dengan kawalan senjata nuklear dalam agenda selepas New START tamat Februari lalu. Seorang pegawai kanan AS memberitahu Reuters tiada perjanjian dijangka; Kremlin menyifatkannya 'amat penting'.
summary.en: The White House says the three leaders will meet on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen on 19 Nov (Kremlin), their first trilateral meeting, with nuclear arms control on the agenda after New START lapsed in February. A senior US official told Reuters no agreement is expected; the Kremlin called the meeting 'extremely significant'.

title.bm: Trump, Xi dan Putin akan mengadakan sidang kemuncak tiga hala pertama di APEC Shenzhen pada 19 Nov
title.en: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit at APEC in Shenzhen on Nov 19

why.bm: Hubungan AS-China-Rusia mempengaruhi perdagangan, tarif serta perang Ukraine dan Iran, termasuk prospek eksport Malaysia.
why.en: US-China-Russia ties shape trade, tariffs and the Ukraine and Iran wars, and Malaysia's export outlook.

summary.bm: Zelenskiy berkata Kyiv belum bersedia menyerahkan wilayah dan hanya akan membawa sebarang perjanjian ke referendum dengan jaminan keselamatan; beliau menolak tawaran gencatan setempat Rusia di Kostiantynivka. Pemimpin EU bersetuju pasukan runding Eropah terdiri daripada Britain, Perancis, Jerman, Itali dan Poland serta pegawai EU.
summary.en: Zelenskiy said Kyiv is not ready to cede land and would put any deal to a referendum only with security guarantees; he rejected Russia's local ceasefire offer for Kostiantynivka. EU leaders agreed a European negotiating team of Britain, France, Germany, Italy and Poland plus EU officials.

title.bm: Zelenskiy: AS cadang Ukraine tinggalkan Donbas sebagai ganti keahlian NATO
title.en: Zelenskiy: US floated Ukraine leaving Donbas in exchange for NATO membership

why.bm: Kali pertama rundingan mengaitkan NATO dengan wilayah; hasilnya membentuk keselamatan Eropah dan harga tenaga.
why.en: First time talks link NATO to territory; the outcome shapes European security and energy prices.

summary.bm: Trump menulis di Truth Social bahawa AS tidak memerlukan perjanjian dengan Iran dan mengawal Hormuz serta wang Iran, sekali gus menghentikan diplomasi Naib Presiden Vance. Tentera Iran berkata empat kapal tangki terkena letupan Khamis; sekurang-kurangnya 10 kapal diserang dalam 10 hari pertama November selepas 37 serangan pada Oktober.
summary.en: Trump wrote on Truth Social that Washington does not need a deal with Iran and controls Hormuz and Iran's money, effectively halting VP Vance's Iran diplomacy. Iran's military says four tankers were hit by explosions on Thursday; at least 10 ships were hit in the first 10 days of November after 37 attacks in October.

title.bm: Trump: AS 'tidak perlukan perjanjian' dengan Iran ketika serangan kapal di Hormuz berterusan
title.en: Trump says US 'doesn't need a deal' with Iran as Hormuz ship attacks continue

why.bm: Meningkatkan kebarangkalian gangguan Hormuz berpanjangan, mengekalkan tekanan harga minyak, kos penghantaran dan subsidi bahan api Malaysia.
why.en: Raises the odds of a long Hormuz disruption, keeping oil, shipping costs and Malaysian fuel/subsidy pressure elevated.

summary.bm: Badan pengawas PBB menggesa Iran membenarkan pemeriksaan semula. Dewan Pakar Iran menyeru semakan keahlian NPT, dan Tehran menolak penghantaran uranium diperkaya 60% ke luar negara.
summary.en: The UN watchdog called on Iran to allow inspections again. Iran's Assembly of Experts has called for a review of NPT membership, and Tehran rejected sending its 60% enriched uranium abroad.

title.bm: IAEA gesa Iran buka semula tapak nuklear untuk pemeriksaan ketika Tehran menimbang keluar NPT
title.en: IAEA urges Iran to reopen nuclear sites to inspection as Tehran weighs NPT exit

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko serangan semula dan gangguan Teluk yang lebih luas sehingga menaikkan harga minyak.
why.en: Raises the risk of renewed strikes and wider Gulf disruption that would lift oil prices.

summary.bm: Von der Leyen berkata Suruhanjaya akan membentangkan pakej itu dan cadangan pembiayaan Ukraine 2027; diplomat menjangka langkah membabitkan bank, kripto dan jalan pintas negara ketiga.
summary.en: Von der Leyen said the Commission will present the package and 2027 Ukraine funding proposals; diplomats expect measures on banks, crypto and third-country loopholes.

title.bm: EU bentang pakej sekatan Rusia ke-22 sebelum sidang khas 26-27 Nov
title.en: EU to unveil 22nd Russia sanctions package before special summit on 26-27 Nov

why.bm: Sekatan lebih ketat menjejaskan aliran tenaga, perbankan dan perdagangan.
why.en: Tighter sanctions affect energy, banking and trade flows.

summary.bm: Kumpulan diketuai UK, Qatar dan Jordan menuntut lebih banyak bekalan; Israel berkata kritikan itu mengalih perhatian daripada Hamas dan menghalang kemasukan barangan dwiguna. 'Board of Peace' menyifatkan tindak balas Israel terhadap banjir tidak mencukupi.
summary.en: A group led by the UK, Qatar and Jordan demanded more supplies; Israel says the criticism diverts attention from Hamas and is resisting entry of dual-use items. The 'Board of Peace' called Israel's response to the floods insufficient.

title.bm: 50+ negara desak Israel benarkan lebih banyak bantuan musim sejuk ke Gaza yang dilanda banjir
title.en: 50+ countries press Israel to allow more winter aid into flood-hit Gaza

why.bm: Tekanan kemanusiaan terhadap Israel dan diplomasi gencatan senjata terus menjadi tumpuan.
why.en: Humanitarian pressure on Israel and ceasefire diplomacy remain in focus.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tersedia dalam AI Studio, API Gemini, aplikasi Gemini dan Carian, berharga $1.50 sejuta token input dan $7.50 sejuta token output dengan konteks 1 juta token. Google mendakwa ia hampir setara Carbon pada Terminal-Bench 4.0 dengan penggunaan kuota 24% lebih rendah (angka syarikat).
summary.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search, priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1M-token context. Google says it nears Carbon on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota use (company figures).

title.bm: Google lancarkan Gemini 4 Hydrogen merentasi API, aplikasi dan Carian
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen across API, app and Search

why.bm: Peringkat Gemini yang lebih murah meningkatkan tekanan harga ke atas API AI pesaing.
why.en: A cheaper Gemini tier raises price pressure on rival AI APIs.

summary.bm: Anthropic mengakui ralat pengesahan meningkat sekitar 17:58 MYT, dengan gangguan besar pada claude.ai dan separa pada Claude Code dan Console; Downdetector merekod 2,895 laporan pada kemuncak.
summary.en: Anthropic acknowledged elevated authentication errors around 17:58 MYT, with a major outage for claude.ai and partial for Claude Code and Console; Downdetector logged 2,895 reports at peak.

title.bm: Claude.ai terjejas gangguan pengesahan; API kekal berfungsi
title.en: Claude.ai hit by authentication outage; API stays up

why.bm: Gunakan API sebagai alternatif dan semak status.claude.com.
why.en: Use the API as a fallback and check status.claude.com.

summary.bm: Pelancaran terhad kepada pengguna ChatGPT Pro AS berumur 18+ dengan kad AS; pembelian ditokenkan dan memerlukan kelulusan Face ID atau cap jari. Had perbelanjaan dirancang tetapi belum aktif.
summary.en: Rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ with US cards; purchases are tokenised and need Face ID or fingerprint approval. Spending limits are planned but not yet live.

title.bm: ChatGPT Wallet dilancarkan supaya ejen AI boleh membeli-belah dan membayar
title.en: ChatGPT Wallet launches so AI agents can shop and check out

why.bm: Belum tersedia di Malaysia; tunggu had perbelanjaan.
why.en: Not available in Malaysia for now; wait for spending limits.

summary.bm: Penjejak keluaran menyenaraikan carian web, input fail/URL, OCR/ASR/TTS dan deepseek-flash merentas format API; ini daripada data penjejak, bukan kenyataan rasmi.
summary.en: A release tracker lists web search, file/URL input, OCR/ASR/TTS and deepseek-flash across its API formats; this comes from tracker data, not an official post.

title.bm: DeepSeek tambah carian web, input fail dan suara pada suite API (laporan penjejak)
title.en: DeepSeek adds web search, file input and voice to its API suite (tracker report)

why.bm: Anggap belum disahkan sehingga DeepSeek menerbitkan butiran.
why.en: Treat as unconfirmed until DeepSeek publishes details.

summary.bm: Tawaran membabitkan 825 juta saham Kelas A dengan simbol 'ANT', menyiratkan penilaian sekitar $916 bilion-$1.02 trilion atas 13.09 bilion saham, dengan opsyen penaja jamin 123.75 juta saham.
summary.en: The offering is 825M Class A shares under ticker 'ANT', implying a valuation of roughly $916B-$1.02T on 13.09B shares, with a 123.75M-share underwriter option.

title.bm: Anthropic tetapkan julat IPO $70-$78; harga dijangka 18 Nov, dagangan Nasdaq 19 Nov
title.en: Anthropic sets IPO range of $70-$78; pricing expected Nov 18, Nasdaq trading Nov 19

why.bm: Julat ini sebelum penetapan harga; semak semula 18-19 Nov.
why.en: The range is pre-pricing; re-check on Nov 18-19.

summary.bm: Fable 5.2 ialah model asas sama dengan Mythos 5.2 dengan perlindungan siber dan biologi lebih kuat, berharga $8/$40 per juta token ($16/$80 mod pantas). Anthropic masih menyifatkan Claude Opus 5.5 pilihan harian terbaik.
summary.en: Fable 5.2 is the same underlying model as Mythos 5.2 with stronger cyber and biology safeguards, priced at $8/$40 per million tokens ($16/$80 in fast mode). Anthropic still calls Claude Opus 5.5 its best daily driver.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Fable 5.2 untuk semua pengguna; Mythos 5.2 terhad kepada organisasi disahkan
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 to all users; Mythos 5.2 limited to vetted orgs

why.bm: Semak kos dan had penggunaan sebelum bertukar model.
why.en: Check cost and usage limits before switching models.

summary.bm: Tampalan kecemasan membaiki kelemahan tahap tinggi yang dieksploitasi sejak akhir Oktober untuk akses root dan kegigihan. Berasingan, get laluan Check Point yang terdedah diserang melalui PHP2Shell yang memasang perisian pemadam data pada hos VMware ESXi.
summary.en: Emergency hotfixes fix a high-severity flaw exploited since late October for root access and persistence. Separately, vulnerable Check Point gateways were hit with PHP2Shell attacks that dropped data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

title.bm: Check Point tampal sifar-hari get laluan yang dieksploitasi; pemadam ESXi dipasang melalui PHP2Shell
title.en: Check Point patches exploited gateway zero-day; ESXi wiper deployed via PHP2Shell

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: pasang hotfix Check Point sekarang dan semak log get laluan serta ESXi.
why.en: Network admins: apply the Check Point hotfix now and review gateway and ESXi logs.

summary.bm: Penyerang mengeksploitasi kelemahan N-central beberapa jam selepas PoC diterbitkan, menjangkiti sekurang-kurangnya 21 pelayan (19 pada hotfix terkini) dan memasang pelombong kripto. N-able mematikan Legacy API secara lalai dan integrasi Intune pada persekitaran dihoskan.
summary.en: Attackers exploited N-central flaws within hours of a PoC release, infecting at least 21 servers (19 on the latest hotfix) and deploying crypto miners. N-able has disabled the Legacy API by default and Intune integration in hosted environments.

title.bm: Kelemahan sifar-hari N-able N-central 'Able2Shell' dieksploitasi selepas PoC diterbitkan
title.en: N-able N-central 'Able2Shell' zero-days exploited after researcher publishes PoC

why.bm: Jika anda menggunakan N-central (biasa pada MSP dan pasukan IT), pasang HF2 segera dan semak pendedahan.
why.en: If you run N-central (common with MSPs and IT teams), apply HF2 now and review exposure.

summary.bm: Tahap dinaikkan daripada Rendah ke Sederhana pada 4 Nov berikutan ketegangan geopolitik dan pendedahan pusat data; infrastruktur kritikal mesti mematuhi sembilan langkah termasuk pemantauan 24 jam dan MFA. Fahmi berkata tiada insiden membimbangkan disahkan semasa PRN Melaka.
summary.en: The level moved from Low to Medium on 4 Nov citing geopolitical tension and data-centre exposure; critical infrastructure must follow nine measures including 24-hour monitoring and MFA. Fahmi said no worrying incidents were confirmed during the Melaka polls.

title.bm: NACSA amaran amber selepas menaikkan tahap ancaman siber negara ke Sederhana
title.en: NACSA on amber alert after raising national cyber threat level to Medium

why.bm: Syarikat: tampal peranti sempadan dan kuatkuasa MFA; orang ramai: rujuk NACSA untuk maklumat rasmi.
why.en: Firms: patch edge devices and enforce MFA; public: rely on NACSA for official updates.

summary.bm: The Hacker News melaporkan Google mengeluarkan kemas kini keselamatan Chrome bagi satu lagi kelemahan sifar-hari yang dieksploitasi, yang kelapan tahun ini.
summary.en: The Hacker News reports Google has shipped a Chrome security update for another zero-day exploited in the wild, the eighth this year.

title.bm: Google keluarkan kemas kini Chrome bagi kelemahan sifar-hari kelapan yang dieksploitasi pada 2026
title.en: Google issues Chrome update for the eighth actively exploited zero-day of 2026

why.bm: Kemas kini Chrome dan pelayar Chromium lain (Edge) ke versi terkini dan mulakan semula.
why.en: Update Chrome and other Chromium browsers (Edge) to the latest version and restart.

summary.bm: Media keselamatan melaporkan kemas kini ini membaiki lebih 1,000 kerentanan, dengan zero-day Outlook yang sudah diserang dan membolehkan kecurian kredensial terhash. Jumlah tepat berbeza antara media.
summary.en: Security outlets report the update fixes more than 1,000 vulnerabilities, with an Outlook zero-day already under attack that allows theft of hashed credentials. Exact totals differ between outlets.

title.bm: Patch Tuesday November Microsoft membaiki lebih 1,000 kelemahan, termasuk zero-day Outlook yang dieksploitasi
title.en: Microsoft November Patch Tuesday fixes over 1,000 flaws, including an exploited Outlook zero-day

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini Windows dan Office November sekarang, utamakan Outlook dan mesin yang terdedah ke internet.
why.en: Install the November Windows and Office updates now, prioritising Outlook and any internet-facing machines.

summary.bm: Item kritikal termasuk RCE GUI FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer (CVE-2026-126170), pintasan pengesahan OSPF FortiOS (CVE-2026-126253) dan RCE FortiMail (CVE-2026-126147); tiada yang disenaraikan dieksploitasi.
summary.en: Critical items include FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer GUI RCE (CVE-2026-126170), FortiOS OSPF auth bypass (CVE-2026-126253) and FortiMail RCE (CVE-2026-126147); none is listed as exploited.

title.bm: Fortinet keluarkan 89 nasihat, 19 kritikal, termasuk kelemahan FortiManager dan FortiOS
title.en: Fortinet issues 89 advisories, 19 critical, including FortiManager and FortiOS flaws

why.bm: Peralatan rangkaian: kemas kini FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer 7.6.8 atau 7.4.12; FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13 atau 7.2.14; FortiOS 8.0.2 masih perlu penyelesaian sementara bagi CVE-2026-126170.
why.en: Network gear: patch to FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer 7.6.8 or 7.4.12; FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13 or 7.2.14; FortiOS 8.0.2 still needs the workaround for CVE-2026-126170.

summary.bm: Dua kelemahan Barracuda ESG (CVE-2026-116606, CVE-2026-111560) digabung memberi akses root; pintasan SAML SSLVPN SonicOS (CVE-2026-19868) hanya terpakai jika SAML diaktifkan. Rantaian Ivanti Connect Secure ditambah pada 30 Okt.
summary.en: Two Barracuda ESG flaws (CVE-2026-116606, CVE-2026-111560) combine to give root; the SonicOS SSLVPN SAML bypass (CVE-2026-19868) applies only where SAML is enabled. Ivanti Connect Secure chains were added on 30 Oct.

title.bm: KEV CISA tambah kelemahan Barracuda ESG dan SonicWall SSLVPN yang dieksploitasi
title.en: CISA KEV adds Barracuda ESG and SonicWall SSLVPN flaws exploited in the wild

why.bm: Semak nasihat setiap vendor sekarang; nyahaktifkan SAML pada SSLVPN jika tidak dapat tampal. Sumber ialah ringkasan sekunder.
why.en: Check each vendor advisory now; disable SAML on SSLVPN if you cannot patch. Source is a secondary roundup.

summary.bm: Kelemahan tulis luar sempadan tanpa pengesahan yang boleh dicapai dari LAN membolehkan pelaksanaan arahan OS melalui permintaan HTTP khas (CVSS 8.8). The Hacker News mengaitkan eksploitasi dengan kumpulan Kapibala (Red Heron); Zyxel telah mengeluarkan pembaikan.
summary.en: An unauthenticated out-of-bounds write reachable from the LAN can allow OS command execution via a crafted HTTP request (CVSS 8.8). The Hacker News attributes the exploitation to a group tracked as Kapibala (Red Heron); Zyxel has released a fix.

title.bm: Kelemahan suis Zyxel GS1900 (CVE-2026-107441) dieksploitasi pada kira-kira 1,000 peranti
title.en: Zyxel GS1900 switch flaw (CVE-2026-107441) exploited on about 1,000 devices

why.bm: Jurutera rangkaian: pasang pembaikan perisian tegar Zyxel dan jauhkan pengurusan suis daripada segmen LAN tidak dipercayai.
why.en: Network engineers: apply the Zyxel firmware fix and keep switch management off untrusted LAN segments.

summary.bm: Menjejaskan sistem Linux yang menjalankan OpenSSH pada musl dengan PAM dimatikan, termasuk konfigurasi lalai pelayan OpenSSH Alpine (CVSS 8.1). Laporan mencatat 20 percubaan eksploitasi daripada 13 IP setakat 9 Nov.
summary.en: Affects Linux systems running OpenSSH on musl with PAM disabled, including Alpine's default OpenSSH server config (CVSS 8.1). The report counts 20 exploitation attempts from 13 IPs as of 9 Nov.

title.bm: Kelemahan OpenSSH 'SSHole' (CVE-2026-123158) benarkan log masuk akaun tanpa kata laluan pada persediaan gaya Alpine
title.en: OpenSSH 'SSHole' flaw (CVE-2026-123158) lets accounts with no password sign in on Alpine-style setups

why.bm: Kemas kini OpenSSH dan pastikan tiada akaun tanpa kata laluan.
why.en: Patch OpenSSH and make sure no account is left without a password.

summary.bm: Pepijat CVSS 7.7 ini membolehkan penyerang rangkaian memasang pakej tidak disahkan apabila APT guna sumber HTTP dengan tetapan cuba semula. Ringkasan mingguan The Hacker News memetik nasihat Amazon.
summary.en: The CVSS 7.7 bug lets a network attacker get an unverified package installed when APT uses HTTP sources with retry settings. The Hacker News weekly recap cites an Amazon advisory.

title.bm: Kelemahan APT Debian/Ubuntu (CVE-2026-109518) boleh membenarkan pelaksanaan kod sebagai root melalui sumber HTTP
title.en: Debian/Ubuntu APT flaw (CVE-2026-109518) can give root code execution via HTTP sources

why.bm: Kemas kini APT dan guna cermin HTTPS pada pelayan serta peranti rangkaian berasaskan Debian/Ubuntu.
why.en: Patch APT and prefer HTTPS mirrors on servers and network appliances built on Debian/Ubuntu.

summary.bm: Satu sistem DigiCert boleh diakses umum lebih 16 bulan, mendedahkan data hubungan pelanggan dan sebahagian dokumen pengenalan. Berasingan, pengurus kata laluan mSecure menggesa pengguna tukar kata laluan dan tetap semula 2FA selepas aktiviti mencurigakan.
summary.en: A DigiCert system was reachable publicly for more than 16 months, exposing customer contact data and some ID documents. Separately, password manager mSecure urged users to change passwords and reset 2FA after suspicious activity.

title.bm: DigiCert: data hubungan pelanggan dan sebahagian dokumen pengenalan terdedah
title.en: DigiCert says customer contact data and some ID documents were exposed

why.bm: Berhati-hati dengan pancingan data yang guna maklumat bocor; pengguna mSecure perlu tukar kata laluan dan 2FA sekarang.
why.en: Watch for phishing that uses leaked details; mSecure users should reset passwords and 2FA now.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: iPad mini OLED dengan A20 Pro, iMac M6 dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M6 serta MacBook Pro 14 dan 16 inci OLED skrin sentuh dilancarkan 6 Nov. MacTech turut melaporkan hasil suku keempat Apple naik 12%.
summary.en: The iPad mini with OLED and A20 Pro, M6 iMac and M6 14-inch MacBook Pro plus OLED touchscreen 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros launched Nov 6. MacTech also reports Apple's fourth-quarter revenue rose 12%.

title.bm: Lima produk baharu Apple dijual; HomeView dan Apple TV 4K menyusul 13 Nov
title.en: Apple's five new products go on sale; HomeView and Apple TV 4K follow on Nov 13

why.bm: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dihantar dalam dua hingga tiga minggu.
why.en: Touchscreen MacBook Pros ship in two to three weeks.

summary.bm: ProductNation melaporkan pra-pesanan dibuka di kedai Apple Malaysia, dengan ketersediaan dari 6 Nov. iPad mini OLED bermula RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, tambah RM700 untuk selular), dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M5 Pro skrin sentuh dengan 24GB dan 1TB bermula RM11,999.
summary.en: ProductNation reports pre-orders are open on Apple's Malaysian store, with availability from Nov 6. The OLED iPad mini starts at RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, RM700 more for cellular), and the touchscreen 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB and 1TB starts at RM11,999.

title.bm: Harga Malaysia ditetapkan: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dari RM11,999, iPad mini dari RM2,999, dihantar 6 Nov
title.en: Malaysia prices set: touchscreen MacBook Pro from RM11,999, iPad mini from RM2,999, shipping Nov 6

why.bm: Ini menjawab persoalan harga Malaysia sebelum pelancaran Jumaat.
why.en: This answers the open Malaysian pricing question before Friday's launch.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Tajuk berita menyebut ia membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan (tajuk sahaja; halaman tidak dibuka).
summary.en: Headlines say it fixes almost 180 vulnerabilities (headline only; page not opened).

title.bm: Samsung lancar tampalan keselamatan November untuk Galaxy S26 dan Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung rolls out November security patch to Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini pada telefon Galaxy anda.
why.en: Install the update on your Galaxy phone.

summary.bm: Ia meliputi Pixel 6a hingga Pixel 11 Pro Fold dengan 33 pembaikan Pixel; tahap tampalan 2026-11-01 dan 2026-11-05 disertakan.
summary.en: It covers Pixel 6a through Pixel 11 Pro Fold with 33 Pixel fixes; patch levels 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05 are included.

title.bm: Android 17 QPR2 dikeluarkan awal bersama Feature Drop dan tampalan keselamatan Pixel November
title.en: Android 17 QPR2 ships early with November Pixel Feature Drop and security patch

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > System > System update.
why.en: Update via Settings > System > System update.

summary.bm: Kumpulan Threat Intelligence Google dan polis Jepun mengganggu pelayan kawalan dan mengharamkan pembuat Videostrong daripada menghasilkan peranti Android bertauliah. Penutupan itu tidak membersihkan kotak yang dijangkiti, dan Google berkata ia mungkin memutuskan sekurang-kurangnya 10 juta lagi peranti yang terjejas. NACSA berkata malware XCPE ditanam dalam peranti semasa pembuatan.
summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and Japan's police disrupted the command servers and banned maker Videostrong from making certified Android devices. The takedown does not clean infected boxes, and Google says it may cut off at least 10 million more compromised devices. NACSA says the XCPE malware was planted in devices during manufacture.

title.bm: Google ganggu botnet XCPE yang menjangkiti lebih 1.3 juta kotak Android TV
title.en: Google disrupts XCPE botnet that infected over 1.3 million Android TV boxes

why.bm: Kotak Android TV murah tanpa jenama biasa di Malaysia; semak kotak anda dan pertimbangkan menggantinya jika terjejas.
why.en: Cheap unbranded Android TV boxes are common in Malaysia; check yours and consider replacing it if it is affected.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata kemas kini November membaiki lebih 200 kelemahan; The Hacker News menyebut CVE-2026-58868, kelemahan kritikal yang membolehkan pelaksanaan kod jauh tanpa interaksi pengguna pada Android 14 hingga 17.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says the November updates fix over 200 vulnerabilities; The Hacker News notes CVE-2026-58868, a critical flaw allowing remote code execution without user interaction on Android 14 to 17.

title.bm: Kemas kini Android November tampal 200+ kelemahan, termasuk RCE kritikal CVE-2026-58868
title.en: Android November updates patch 200+ flaws, including critical RCE CVE-2026-58868

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini keselamatan Android terkini sebaik sahaja tersedia pada telefon anda.
why.en: Install the latest Android security update as soon as it reaches your phone.

summary.bm: Outlook, Teams dan Copilot terganggu beberapa jam dengan kira-kira 200,000 laporan Downdetector; perkhidmatan beransur pulih lewat 13 Nov.
summary.en: Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down for hours with about 200,000 Downdetector reports; services were recovering later on Nov 13.

title.bm: Gangguan global Microsoft menyebabkan jutaan pengguna hilang akses Outlook, Teams dan alat lain
title.en: Global Microsoft outage leaves millions without Outlook, Teams and other tools

why.bm: Perniagaan yang bergantung pada Microsoft 365 patut mempunyai saluran sandaran ketika gangguan.
why.en: Businesses relying on Microsoft 365 should have a fallback channel for outages.

summary.bm: Lembaga pengarah mengumumkan peletakan jawatan serta-merta selepas siasatan dan mula mencari CEO tetap; saham jatuh sekitar 7.7% dalam satu tangkapan skrin, melenyapkan ratusan bilion nilai. Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Perbankan Senat AS menyeru Huang dan Setiausaha Perdagangan Lutnick memberi keterangan, dan firma AI China berebut kapasiti cip Nvidia kerana bimbang sekatan AS.
summary.en: The board announced the immediate resignation after an investigation and began a search for a permanent CEO; shares fell about 7.7% in one snapshot, wiping out hundreds of billions in value. A US Senate Banking chair has called for Huang and Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify, and Chinese AI firms are racing to secure Nvidia chip capacity over fears of US curbs.

title.bm: Ketua Eksekutif Nvidia Jensen Huang letak jawatan; CFO Colette Kress dilantik CEO sementara
title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO

why.bm: Nvidia penanda aras cip AI; kejutan ini menjejaskan saham teknologi global serta rantaian bekalan pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia is the AI-chip bellwether; the shock hit global tech stocks and Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor supply chain.

summary.bm: Perjanjian bersama itu memberi modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion (SoftBank AS$1 bilion, Grab AS$750 juta, Petros AS$100 juta), menyasarkan 5 GW atau lebih di Sarawak dan Semenanjung secara berperingkat.
summary.en: The joint deals give seed capital of US$1.85bn (SoftBank US$1bn, Grab US$750m, Petros US$100m), targeting 5 GW or more across Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia in stages.

title.bm: SoftBank, Grab dan Petros bina kemudahan AI besar di Malaysia dengan modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion
title.en: SoftBank, Grab and Petros to build large AI facilities in Malaysia with US$1.85bn seed capital

why.bm: Menambah pembangunan pusat data Malaysia dan Pelan Tindakan AI Nasional 2026-2030.
why.en: Adds to Malaysia's data-centre build-out and the National AI Action Plan 2026-2030.

summary.bm: Google berkata tambahan AS$15 bilion akan mengembangkan pusat datanya di Malaysia dalam dua tahun dan menjangka 37,000 pekerjaan. Anwar mengalu-alukan pelaburan itu.
summary.en: Google says the extra US$15 billion will expand its Malaysian data centre footprint over two years and projects 37,000 jobs. Anwar hailed the investment.

title.bm: Google tambah komitmen AS$15 bilion untuk pusat data Malaysia dalam tempoh dua tahun
title.en: Google commits another US$15bn to Malaysian data centres over two years

why.bm: Rangsangan besar kepada ekosistem pusat data dan awan serta pekerjaan teknologi di Malaysia.
why.en: A big boost for Malaysia's data-centre and cloud ecosystem and tech jobs.

summary.bm: BMI berkata ia memerlukan kira-kira 30 TWj setahun menjelang 2031, 18% bekalan berbanding 6% pada 2026; TNB merancang RM43 bilion untuk menaik taraf grid.
summary.en: BMI says they would need about 30 TWh a year by 2031, 18% of supply versus 6% in 2026; TNB plans RM43b for grid upgrades.

title.bm: Pusat data Johor boleh guna lebih 90% kapasiti kuasa baharu Semenanjung
title.en: Johor data centres could take over 90% of Peninsular Malaysia's new power capacity

why.bm: Grid, bukan pembinaan, ialah halangan; jangka kelewatan dan tekanan tarif.
why.en: The grid, not construction, is the bottleneck; expect delays and tariff pressure.

note.bm: Li Qiang bertemu pemimpin 16 Nov; Trump tiba 17 Nov untuk sidang ASEAN-AS dan Quad.
note.en: Li Qiang meets leaders 16 Nov; Trump arrives 17 Nov for ASEAN-US summit and Quad.

title.bm: Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-49, Manila (hingga 18 Nov)
title.en: 49th ASEAN Summit, Manila (to 18 Nov)

note.bm: Anwar pulang dari Manila untuk menyambutnya, kemudian kembali ke sana.
note.en: Anwar returns from Manila to receive him, then flies back.

title.bm: Macron melawat Malaysia
title.en: Macron visits Malaysia

note.en: Pricing for the $70-$78 range is expected 18 Nov.

title.bm: Sidang Kemuncak APEC, Shenzhen (18-19 Nov); harga IPO Anthropic dijangka
title.en: APEC Leaders' Summit, Shenzhen (18-19 Nov); Anthropic IPO pricing expected

note.bm: Kawalan senjata nuklear dan perang Iran dalam agenda; Ukraine di landasan berasingan.
note.en: Nuclear arms and the Iran war on agenda; Ukraine on a separate track.

title.bm: Pertemuan tiga hala Trump–Xi–Putin; Anthropic mula didagangkan di Nasdaq (ANT)
title.en: Trump–Xi–Putin three-way meeting; Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq (ANT)

note.bm: Dijadual 20 Nov menurut akhbar perniagaan UK.
note.en: Set for 20 Nov per UK business press.

title.bm: Sidang kemuncak UK–EU
title.en: UK–EU summit

note.bm: Pakej sekatan Rusia ke-22 dan pembiayaan Ukraine dijangka.
note.en: 22nd Russia sanctions package and Ukraine funding expected.

title.bm: Majlis Eropah khas (26-27 Nov)
title.en: Special European Council (26-27 Nov)

title.en: ECRL passenger service launch
